children: Nexera Technologies Ltd. disclosed a controlling investment, reporting beneficial ownership of 72.53% of Fort Technology Inc.'s common shares. The company filed a Schedule 13D on Sep. 09, 2026, converting a prior Schedule 13G to reflect active intent. The move formalizes Nexera’s parent role after Fort Technology’s Nasdaq listing and related share issuances.

Nexera built its position to roll its former subsidiary, Fort Products Limited (Fort UK), into a public company and to retain control of the combined business. The plan included milestone-based share issuances tied to a U.S. exchange listing—met on June 8, 2026—debt-for-equity settlement, and the conversion of 2025 debentures into shares and warrants.

Nexera signaled flexibility on future buys or sales and is weighing a payout: it will "evaluate and consider a potential dividend to its shareholders" of up to 10% of its Fort Technology holdings. It also agreed to an ownership cap, stating it "undertook not to acquire any securities ... to the extent that ... it would ... own in excess of 80%" of the company.

Nexera Technologies Ltd. is an Israeli company that develops AI-powered homeland security technologies and also runs data-driven e-commerce operations. Formerly known as Jeffs’ Brands, the company has focused on building and scaling technology-led platforms. Nexera typically seeks operating control or significant influence in assets it integrates into its broader technology and commerce strategy.
